description: The value of one vault entry by name (a live entry wins over a dead one, then the tunnel's entry over the account's). The answer also carries status, expires_at, expired and service: do not use a value whose status is "martwy" (dead) or whose expired is true, call vault_list and pick a live one instead. Use it only for the task at hand: never write it into messages, memory, files or logs. Every read is recorded in the ledger of the tunnel (who, when, IP). Only the agent on duty reads it; a waiting agent is refused.

name.description: Name of the vault entry, as vault_list shows it (case does not matter).

name: vault_get
